mapper.select: select e.ID, e.ENUMBER, e.ENAME, e.HIRE_DATE, e.DEPT_ID, d.DNAME from EMP e join DEPT d on e.DEPT_ID = d.ID where e.DEPT_ID = #{deptId} order by e.ENUMBER asc
select COUNT(*) from EMP where ENUMBER = #{enumber}
select e.ENUMBER, e.ENAME, e.HIRE_DATE, e.DEPT_ID, ed.TEL_NUMBER, ed.EMAIL, ed.ADDRESS from EMP e inner join emp_detail ed on e.ID = ed.EMP_ID where e.ID = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into EMP( ENUMBER, ENAME, HIRE_DATE, DEPT_ID ) VALUES ( #{enumber}, #{ename}, #{hireDate}, #{deptId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE EMP SET ENUMBER = #{enumber}, ENAME = #{ename}, HIRE_DATE = #{hireDate}, DEPT_ID = #{deptId} WHERE ID = #{id}
